name: Applicability Rule
description: Child table row defining one rule in an obligation's applicability chain. Rows are evaluated in order; the `logical_operator` column defines how each row combines with the next (AND/OR). The Applicability Engine evaluates the full chain to decide if the obligation applies to a Business Entity.

fields.label: Rule Type
fields.options:
State Match
Industry Match
Employee Threshold
Turnover Threshold
Listed Status
Hazardous Status
MSME Status
Entity Type
Custom Expression
fields.description: What attribute of the Business Entity this rule checks.

fields.label: Operator
fields.options:
equals
not_equals
greater_than
less_than
greater_equal
less_equal
in
not_in
between
fields.description: Comparison operator applied between the entity attribute and the value.

fields.label: Value
fields.description: JSON-encoded value. Scalar: "Maharashtra". List: ["Maharashtra","Goa"]. Range: {"min": 10, "max": 499}. Expression: "entity.employee_count * 1.1 > 100".

fields.label: Logical Op
fields.description: How this rule's result combines with the NEXT row. The last row's logical_operator is ignored.
